text_block_list.name: Kiyomi
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaa~h, Believe-chan!!
That was a great run~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, you were so faaast!!
Keep giving it your all from here on out toooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: That Old Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh look! The folks over there
are cheerin' on Believe-chan too!

text_block_list.name: That Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
She's a good girl, so of course she did!
Come on, we've gotta work harder too!
Loud and proud!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: "Believe-chaaaan!! That was a mighty fine run!!"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(I was able to run exactly as I envisioned.
Establishing the form, building the fundamentals, and gaining race experience.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (And so, in this race... it reached them.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —I see. So it's here.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Am I really still stuck here—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the waiting room, I greeted Believe after her safe finish.
I had endless praise in my heart.
I wanted to shower her with compliments for such a great run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However... there was also something I had to tell her.
And so, for a moment, I hesitated to speak—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Could we change our plans?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The next race should be the Sprinters Stakes, but...
...Before that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please let me squeeze in one more race.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be
you were thinking the exact same thing?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you caught up on the exact same thing?
To me—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: You're saying I lack actual race experience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no choice but to nod in agreement.
It was something I had felt even before the race began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't regret the days spent meticulously building the basics.
It was essential in order to perfect Believe's style of 'sustained speed.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, however, spending that much time
focused solely on training means...
she has very little experience in actual races.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Discipline is important.
But naturally, the real race is just as important.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Pouring everything you've built up into your run.
There are certainly things you can only gain
through that kind of experience.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Besides, senior-class Umamusume will also be running in the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Of course, I can't gain the same amount of experience as my predecessors starting now. But that just means—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That is no excuse to leave things undone.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Give me a chance. A chance to—forge me, to sharpen me into shape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I understand how Believe feels. In fact, I agree from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot simply nod in agreement.
Because—
choice_data_list: (The interval between races is getting too short...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's late August now. The Sprinters Stakes is in September.
If you were to enter a race before then, it would be something like the Centaur Stakes in early September, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running three races in just a month and a half.
And having one of them be a GⅠ...
To be blunt, that's a dangerous schedule.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In a race, Umamusume literally pour in everything.
Into that single, fleeting clash, their stamina, their mental fortitude—and at times, even their very life force.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, each race takes a heavy toll,
especially elite GⅠ showdowns.
That's why proper spacing between runs is standard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I could never simply nod along easily.
That's why I faced her head-on first.
choice_data_list: First off... it's a pretty dangerous path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She might already know it herself.
Even so, I explain it carefully, point by point.
The risks of what we are about to do."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, I confirm it once more.
choice_data_list: Do you want to run? In the Centaur Stakes?
Do you want to run? In the Centaur Stakes?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I—
want fast. I want to be the fastest.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
The form is found.
The foundation is built.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
That is why I will run fast, faster still.
Ever swift, I will sprint straight through.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Faster than anyone else in the world.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I want to do the finest work on the supreme stage—!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like always.
Her calm eyes, unwavering and steadfast as ever, gaze straight at me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that I gave in... to that.
—Right now, I am Believe's colleague."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Staking everything on a mere six furlongs, upon the stage that crowns the fastest.
...Because we resolved to do the finest work together."
choice_data_list: Got it. I'll take full responsibility.
Got it. I'll take full responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ! ...That is—
choice_data_list: I'll do it. After all, that's my job.
I'll do it. After all, that's my job.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I nod, and then speak with absolute conviction.
choice_data_list: The next race is the Centaur Stakes, Believe.
The next race is the Centaur Stakes, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Yes.
I will bring myself to peak condition. Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Together with you, without fail.
